race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.author: Daniel Justus
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.title: Great feeling glove
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.body: The back on these gloves are very thin and light, so you barely feel them on your hands. Full finger gloves tend to be loose in the palm, but these are pretty tight. I did order a size (or 2) smaller than my normal glove size, usually L to XL, but went with medium. They fit great. I only dropped it 1 star because I'm barely through the second season (and I don't ride a lot) and the stitching on the thumb portion of the palm is already coming apart. I would expect these to last longer, especially if someone is using them for actual racing.

race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.author: Talan Gilley
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.title: Very great product
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.body: These are very great gloves. Have great grip

race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.author: Patricia Gillogly
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.title: jet ski gloves
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.body: these gloves are very comfortable and reduce hand stress while operating my wave runner. Glad I got them. no more blisters or chafing.

race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.author: Dan
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.title: Probably won't stop blisters
race-skin-pwc-gloves-blue-jetski-ride-ra.body: I've had several different gloves, some full finger, and some half finger. Every set of full finger gloves (these included) tend to be loose in the palm (or just before your fingers start). This causes them to move around on your hand and ends up causing blisters (typically the reason you wear gloves in the first place). Half finger gloves tend to be snug in the palm, but sometimes don't cover enough of the thumb to protect it from rubbing. When I bought these I wen't a size smaller than I would normally wear. The gloves are overall very snug, except for in the palm area. Not sure why it's so hard to make the palm snug. Still to cold here to ride, but I'm going to give them a try either way. Outside of that they seem to be nice gloves.

freedom-shoulder-duffel-bag.title: Nice gear bag

It does not rub under the arms like some other vests do. It is a SIDE entry vest which I have always preferred over the front entry ones. I also like the fact that this is a 2 buckle vest and not a three. As for the quality, my friend has had his for about 3 years now and is still using it so it must be good.

new-upgraded-boots-grb-4-0-race-boot-pwc.author: Jason
new-upgraded-boots-grb-4-0-race-boot-pwc.title: Everything was great about these except the straps. They are way too long. Had to return them.
new-upgraded-boots-grb-4-0-race-boot-pwc.body: I had a size 12. The poorly designed straps made me return these. They were comfy and I wanted to like them, but could not get past how long the straps were. It was noticeable even when taking the shoes out of the box for the first time. With them on they hang way off the side. Almost to the point of hitting the ground. It seems that they could get hit and come loose pretty easily. First problem is the bottom strap where zipper is. The shoe is not going to get bigger than where the zipper zips up, yet the strap for it is about twice as long as it needs to be. When you strap it so it perfectly folds to the velcro there is still about a 2 inch gap between the strap and the zipper no matter if your foot is in it or not. Then when you actually try and strap it tight it sticks way farther than it needs to be. Basically touching the ground. Moving on to the strap at the top. I have to basically use the whole strap and it is sticking way way off the side. I called and asked about the issue and they said that is how they were designed and that my feet were probably too narrow. Let me say when my foot was in the shoe and zipped up it fit in there snug and perfect. The straps were the issue not my foot. Not sure how these made it out of a RnD Prototype. I figured they would have had this figured out especially since this is the 3rd version of this shoe. I would question the designer and whoever approved these for production. If they fixed the straps I would consider buying them, but until then I will probably buy some Hiyaks from Astral. JETTRIBE UPDATE - We appreciate the feedback and will be reviewing the design of the straps for future productions.
